source.title: Princeton campus mapped point features · OpenStreetMap snapshot

semantics.scope: University campus boundary baseline plus explicit retained-way perimeter context; not a complete campus inventory. Acquisition bounds are not a campus ownership boundary.
semantics.coordinates: Original OSM WGS84 longitude/latitude degrees. Bounds enclose all source positions, including unplaced location-review records; no snapping or measured accuracy.
semantics.categories: Crossing: highway=crossing or crossing key; kerb: barrier=kerb or kerb key; entrance: entrance key; transit: highway=bus_stop or public_transport key. Categories overlap and do not count unique physical facilities.
semantics.joins: Way, section and study-area memberships come only from exact node IDs in selected ways. Empty joins stay empty. Authored coordinate audit groupings are not connections or official neighborhoods.
semantics.dates: sourceNode.timestamp is an OSM edit time. Response retrieval dates are not field observation or capture dates; unrecorded dates remain null. Tags are archive assertions, not measured accessibility or current traversal.
semantics.placement: Four source location-fixme records remain in inventory with original coordinates but null normal map geometry pending location review. Source matching and eligible placement are not passability assessments.
